title: REPRO-Bench: Can Agentic AI Systems Assess the Reproducibility of Social Science Research?

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.2: 'All three agents use gpt-4o-2024-05-13 (OpenAI, 2024). Following the original settings of all three agents, we terminate the agents if they incur API costs of over $4 per task.'

prompt.location: Agent scaffolds (AutoGPT, CORE-Agent, SWE-Agent) plus benchmark task descriptions; no prompt text printed

claim.metric: accuracy (% of tasks with correct reproducibility score)

data.source: REPRO-Bench (112 tasks: paper PDF + reproduction package averaging 4.2 GB), GitHub release stated in the abstract

notes: Agentic: needs the three third-party agent frameworks, a sandbox with Stata/MATLAB/LaTeX and multi-GB reproduction packages (~$2 per task run); not a light re-execution.
